value.title: Canary model evidence and fail-closed cross-checks; Unisphere upstream work and pin bumps

sections.name: body
sections.value:
- **Canary model rule** (#306, #308):
  - Prefer the native record (unisphere `model.current`, basis native). Treat `model.pending_switch`, or that field listed as unknown, as pending.
  - For OMP, when the footer names a model, check it against the native selector's own catalog row (`pij_harnesses::omp_model_shows`). Never resolve the footer name: the live catalog has 54 display-name collisions.
  - Disagreement refuses. A catalog error also refuses (F256): a cross-check that is the only guard must fail CLOSED, and `if let Ok(false)` fails open.
  - Test the cross-product: stale evidence plus a check error. Separate tests on each half missed it.
- **The canary calls `observe_bind` with session id None.** A Some id makes the OMP adapter resolve the footer through `omp models` eagerly. The returned id is only an echo of the argument.
- **OMP switches the ACTIVE model for every role.** `setModel(model, role)` covers smol, slow and the other configured roles; `setModelTemporary` covers temporary, fallback and prewalk. Pinned Unisphere 0370cab counted only role default.
- **Unisphere fix:** branch `fix/omp-role-switch-pending` (5b5ef101) on AI-Substrate/Unisphere, not merged.
  - Checkouts are worktrees under `~/substrate/Unisphere/`; the main one is `unishpere-main` (sic).
  - Commit with `harness commit`. Run `harness checks --json` with node_modules symlinked from unishpere-main.
  - The real-CLI status test is `crates/app/tests/omp_role_switch.rs`: HOME set to a temp dir, then `unisphere sessions status --harness oh-my-pi --session X --json`.
- **Pin bump to 5b5ef101 or later:** pij's lib compiles. `crates/unisphere/src/fleet.rs` test `sighting()` needs the new `PrepCallRow.detail` (`PrepCallDetail`, flattened). Status also gains additive fields (`models[]`, `native_cost`, `selected_model`).
- **Since #42, start an OMP seat in its worktree** (`--cwd <wt>`). It runs the worktree's own extension (OMP keys extensions by name, project first).
